typography.instructions: Use Bebas Neue for all H1, H2, H3 and high-impact stats. Use Poppins for descriptions, buttons, and form inputs.

tailwind_config_override: <script>tailwind.config = { theme: { extend: { colors: { base: '#0B0B0F', sunset: '#F4A261', dusty: '#6B7A8F' }, fontFamily: { bebas: ['Bebas Neue', 'sans-serif'], poppins: ['Poppins', 'sans-serif'] } } } }</script>

components_and_sections.name: Preloader
components_and_sections.instructions: Full screen #0B0B0F div with 'VKS CREATE' text in the center. Use GSAP to fade out the text and then slide the preloader div up after 2 seconds to reveal the page.

components_and_sections.name: Custom Cursor & Scroll Progress
components_and_sections.instructions: Desktop only. A glowing dot (using CSS mix-blend-mode: difference or a soft glowing shadow) that follows the mouse using JS. Add a fixed 2px height div at the top of the viewport representing scroll progress, colored with the sunset gradient, updated via JS on scroll.

components_and_sections.name: Navbar
components_and_sections.instructions: Sticky at top, z-50. bg-base/80 with backdrop-blur-md. Logo 'VKS' on left, links (Work, About, Services, Contact) on right. Include a mobile hamburger menu.

components_and_sections.name: Hero Section
components_and_sections.instructions: min-h-screen. Center aligned layout. Animated sunset gradient blob in background (absolute, blur-[120px], opacity-30). Main text: 'VIVEK SOLANKI' in Bebas Neue, text-7xl to text-9xl. Implement a line-by-line reveal using GSAP. Below name, add 'VKS CREATE - ' and a span for Typed.js looping through ('Reels Editing', 'YouTube Editing', 'Color Grading', 'Motion Graphics', 'Thumbnails'). Floating abstract SVG shapes (camera, play button, film strip) with parallax effect on scroll.

components_and_sections.name: Reels Gallery
components_and_sections.instructions: 9:16 vertical items. Use horizontal scroll snap (flex overflow-x-auto snap-x) on mobile and a 4-column grid on desktop. Each item is a card with a thumbnail image, a play icon overlay, and a 'View Badge' (e.g. '1M+ Views') positioned absolute at the top right. Add hover effects to scale up the thumbnail.

components_and_sections.name: About & Stats
components_and_sections.instructions: Section with a cinematic portrait of the editor. Grid of stats: '3+ Years', '100+ Projects', '30+ Clients', '1M+ Views'. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to count up these numbers from 0 when they enter the viewport.

components_and_sections.name: Service Cards
components_and_sections.instructions: 5 cards (Reels, YouTube, Color Grading, Motion Graphics, Thumbnails). Apply Vanilla-tilt.js (data-tilt) to each card. Dark glassmorphism background (bg-white/5) with a 1px border of white/10. On hover, add a soft sunset shadow glow (shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(244,162,97,0.3)]).

components_and_sections.name: Software Marquee
components_and_sections.instructions: Infinite scrolling text/logo marquee. Text like: 'CAPCUT • PREMIERE PRO • AFTER EFFECTS • DAVINCI RESOLVE • VN'. Use CSS keyframes for a continuous horizontal translation. Large Bebas Neue text, outline only (transparent text, white stroke).

components_and_sections.name: Color Grade Slider
components_and_sections.instructions: Interactive before/after slider. A container with two superimposed images. An input type='range' over it to adjust the width of the top image container. Top image: Color Graded. Bottom image: Use CSS filter: grayscale(100%) or sepia on the same base image to simulate 'Raw/Log' footage.

components_and_sections.name: Contact & Footer
components_and_sections.instructions: Formspree HTML form placeholder (Name, Email, Message, Submit). A 'Send via WhatsApp' button (links to wa.me with prefilled text). Footer with social links (Instagram, YouTube, Email).

components_and_sections.name: Floating Action Buttons
components_and_sections.instructions: Fixed bottom-right WhatsApp button with a continuous pulse animation. Fixed bottom-left Back-to-Top button (appears after scrolling 500px).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user requested a single `index.html` file using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. DO NOT initialize a React, Next.js, or Vite project. DO NOT use Shadcn.
Write ALL code (HTML, CSS in <style>, JS in <script>) inside `/app/index.html`.
Use CDN links for Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis, Typed.js, and Vanilla-tilt in the <head>.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header. Use bg-[#0B0B0F]/80 with backdrop-blur-md.
Ensure contrast requirements are met (white text on #0B0B0F).
Build the before/after slider purely with HTML/CSS/JS (an input range absolute-positioned over a masked image container).
Make sure the hero section is extremely cinematic and responsive (mobile first).
Add the custom cursor logic. Hide it on mobile/touch devices using CSS media queries (pointer: coarse).
Implement the continuous scrolling software marquee using CSS @keyframes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements to avoid breaking GSAP transforms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Never use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Design with a mobile-first philosophy, as the primary audience arrives via Instagram.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., visually center play icons inside rounded boxes).
Ensure generous padding between sections (e.g., py-24 or py-32) to let the cinematic visuals breathe.
Buttons should have distinct hover states (e.g., bg-sunset transitioning to a brighter tone, adding glow).
Form inputs must have visible focus states that contrast well against the dark background.
